title: Devil Contract
text: Pay a price to bind a devil. The price sets the tier: Low, Mid, High or Supreme (/devilpact accept tax|seal|maxhp|eye_left|eye_right|half). The Assimilation key (N, rebindable) lets the devil in or pushes it back from 0 to 100%; the magicule drain grows with the level, bonuses follow a smooth curve, wings give flight from 50%, horns show from 20%. At 100% you enter the Devil Union for exactly five minutes, then the level drops to 0 and the union is locked for 24 in-game hours. It excludes the old Anti-Magic Black Form. Half max health and a lost eye last through death.
